g.text: v1 | threshold = 0.5 | shared non-PII dataset names | equal dataset weights | PII reported separately

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Each model uses its own successful samples; aggregate models have no paired sample IDs. Not a fair ranking.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Latency: original models' shared fully timed v1 / 0.5 subset; Qwen follows the same dataset scope:

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: ToxiGen, HateCheck, AEGIS2, Detect-Jailbreak, Jailbreak-Classification, JailbreakHub. Quality and latency dataset scopes can differ.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: APIs: v1 / 0.5 single-run timing. OpenJev 4B: supplied summary; 35B / Decision-1: supplied single-run timing.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: PII is ordinary binary classification (present vs absent), not masking quality; positives-only results are separate.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Missing quality stays N/A; no shared timing subset = N/A latency. Timing protocols differ; not inference time.
